coverage_issues: qwen and deepseek models selected files without the src/apparmor.d-git/ prefix, causing 6 and 3 files respectively to not be reviewed (dists/docker.sh, dists/docstring.sh, share/libalpm/hooks/apparmor.hook, share/zsh/site-functions/_aa-*.zsh)

learnings: Models need better path resolution logic: when files are in src/<pkgname>/, models should be guided to use the full path or the file selection prompt should clarify the directory structure
The audit tool should handle malformed model responses more gracefully by retrying or falling back to a simpler assessment rather than marking the entire audit inconclusive

Free-tier models have reliability issues (rate limiting, availability) that should be factored into audit planning; consider using paid models for critical audits or implementing automatic retry with fallback models
For VCS packages (-git), the audit tool should explicitly confirm that SKIP checksums are expected and not flag them as unpinned sources, reducing noise in the assessment
